capacity:worker-0.title: Worker 0 is down
capacity:worker-0.message: It's saved down, so it handles nothing: messages wait in Order events until it's back.
capacity:worker-0.rationale: A service saved down or paused starts that way in live view. Behind a topic or queue its messages wait; pushed to it, they fail.
